About Gavna

At Gavna, the conviction is that technology must enhance human faculties, never replace them. We design musical and audiovisual tools oriented to streamline the workflow, allowing to keep the focus on the essential: the will of the creator.

In ancient Aramaic, Gavna holds a dual meaning: while literally translated as “color”, it also describes the particular manner, mode, or style in which something is made. Based on this premise, the software presented here will always aim to provide clarity and structure to the workflow, allowing your work to keep its own identity.

Ramiro Piedrabuena — Design & Development
